name: eat_walk
text: A person walks forward at a steady pace while eating a snack, keeping their right hand raised at their mouth the whole time. Their left arm swings naturally and their feet take regular alternating steps. They keep walking without stopping.

trim.reason: The generated 3-cycle take wobbles between keyframes in its first cycle (hip speed 0.7-3.1 m/s) on every seed and keyframe density tried; cycles 2-3 are as smooth as the source. Take frames 29 and 87 are both keyframed to the same source pose, so frames 29-87 are an exact 2-cycle loop. Keyframe frames above are take frames.

pilot: keyframes source = the previously selected eat_walk (4 s, no endpoint constraints; git 10d4ac9), gait cycle frames 62-91 (left heel strike to left heel strike)

review.notes_zh: 循环版（2026-09-25）：从旧 eat_walk 取一个步态周期（62–91 帧）做全身关键帧，生成三周期，取后两周期（59 帧，约 1.97 秒）。右手全程在嘴边（手到头 0.13–0.18 米），左臂摆动，首尾同姿势、只差前进量，可无缝循环；根前进约 3.0 米，前向速度 1.25–2.03 米/秒。不含多口进食或食物实体。
